text: dsh-repeat-stop 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的插件，用来阻止 agent 因相同工具调用反复循环。它通过工具 guard 检查每次调用，并按 agent 分别维护连续调用记录；工具名和参数相同才会累积次数，参数对象键顺序不影响比较。达到配置阈值后，下一次相同调用会被硬拦截并提示改变参数、换工具或结束任务。插件也会在真实用户消息到来时清零该 agent 的计数，并支持启用开关、包含和排除工具名称模式。适合希望给重复失败调用设置明确停止线的 DSH Web 用户；默认允许连续六次，随后拦截，不需要 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-repeat-stop blocks repeated identical DSH tool calls per agent. It compares normalized arguments, stops calls past a configurable threshold, and resets after a user message. Include and exclude patterns select tracked tools. By default, the seventh identical call is blocked.
想让 DSH 在工具调用一直重复时自动停下来
同一个失败命令反复执行，怎么给它设个次数上限？
让 agent 连续调用完全相同的工具几次后就停止
DSH 能不能忽略某些工具的重复调用，其他工具照常拦截？
Stop an agent when it keeps making the exact same tool call.
How can I reset a repeated-call counter when the user sends a new message?
dsh-repeat-stop 的功能「拦截连续重复调用」：按工具名和规范化参数识别同一调用，并按 agent 计数；超过阈值后的下一次调用会被 guard 拦截并给出停止提示。
dsh-repeat-stop 的功能「筛选计数工具」：可用 include 和 exclude 名称模式控制哪些工具参与重复计数，星号可匹配名称片段。
dsh-repeat-stop 的功能「用户消息后重置」：agent 收到真实用户消息时清除自己的连续调用记录，让后续调用重新计数。
想按工具名称设置白名单或排除名单，避免某些调用触发重复拦截
同一参数只是字段顺序不同，也希望被识别为重复调用

dsh-repeat-stop README · Where it sits：Hard-stops a streak of identical tool calls. It does not cap a varied tool session; that is dsh-tool-budget.

dsh-repeat-stop README · Why：Official `repeat-tool-reminder` only advises and never blocks. Agents can still spin on the same failing call. This plugin **denies** the next call after a streak.

Default: **6** identical calls may run; the **7th** is blocked. Changing args/tool or a real user message resets the streak.

dsh-repeat-stop README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:173787247/dsh-repeat-stop
```

Restart `dsh web`. No new tool appears. When it fires, Trajectory shows `dsh-repeat-stop: blocked`.

dsh-repeat-stop README · Config：```yaml
- id: dsh-repeat-stop
  name: dsh-repeat-stop
  config:
    enabled: true

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|-----|---------|---------|
| `enabled` | `true` | Master switch |
| `threshold` | `6` | Allowed streak; next call blocked (integer ≥ 2) |
| `exclude` | job_* | Names that never count |
| `include` | (empty) | If set, only these names are tracked |

dsh-repeat-stop README · vs dsh-tool-budget：| Plugin | What it blocks |
|--------|----------------|
| `dsh-repeat-stop` | Consecutive identical calls |
| `dsh-tool-budget` | Total tool calls in the whole session |
